subject: Supplemental capacity & fee reprice — SOW edits needed
messages:
From: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@helix.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@helix.ai
Date: Fri, 30 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: supplemental capacity + updated fee schedule

Hi Mina,

Quick note from procurement and the infra team: Helix has accelerating demand for inference during our Q4 pilot and we want to add a supplemental pool (approx. +60% of our committed GPU hours) for 6 months. We also need to reprice the Implementation and Support fees for that same window to a fixed monthly fee rather than an hourly setup you currently show in the SOW.

What we need from Redwood:
- A short addendum (order-form + exhibit in SOW) that adds the supplemental throughput and the fixed monthly fee for Implementation & Support for the six month pilot.
- Confirmation that the supplemental pool will be isolated (no data commingling) and covered under the same security terms (SOC2, retention) in our MSA.
- High-level timelines: start date target 2027-09-01; onboarding estimate 3 weeks.

Attached is a one-page procurement summary to speed the review. Can you loop in legal and product to confirm next steps and a target turnaround? We are on a tight timeline for budget approval (first week of August).

Thanks,
Sarah
Sarah Lin
Head of Cloud Ops, Helix AI
procurement@helix.ai

Attachment: helix-supplemental-request-2027-07-30.pdf (summary, 1 page)

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@helix.ai>
Date: Fri, 30 Jul 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: supplemental capacity + updated fee schedule

Sarah — thanks for the clear brief and the timeline. Looping in Jordan (sales ops) and Karthik (legal/finance touchpoint) so we can triage. High level from Redwood: we can support a time-limited supplemental pool and offer a fixed monthly fee for Implementation & Support for the pilot, subject to an amendment to the Order Form + Exhibit B (SOW). A few internal asks up-front so we scope the SOW edits properly: 

1) Precise throughput profile: is the +60% spike steady-state or bursty (e.g., 80% of hours concentrated in 4 weeks)?
2) Desired SLA for the supplemental pool (we can offer same SLA as committed or a lower-tier with discount).
3) Billing preference: bill as a standalone supplement line item vs. amortize against committed capacity.

Jordan/Karthik — can you advise on the fastest route for a six-week turnaround (legal redline + commercial signoff + DocuSign)? I propose we:
- Draft an order-form addendum with new line items and an Exhibit B SOW patch that includes implementation schedule (3 weeks) and isolation language.
- Redline only the affected exhibits and circulate with a trackable DocuSign envelope; ask Helix to confirm SLA choice so we lock the fee.

Sarah — I’ll send a PO-friendly addendum outline by EOD Monday.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2027 11:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Draft redlines and execution plan (Helix supplemental)

Team — I uploaded a first-pass redline of Exhibit B and a short addendum to the order form. Highlights:
- Added Exhibit B.3: "Supplemental Capacity — Pilot" with clear start/end dates (2027-09-01 to 2028-02-29) and isolation language (single-tenant pool for Helix).
- Implementation & Support fee converted to a fixed monthly fee, with a 10% discount applied to the fixed fee instead of the usual hourly rates for the pilot window.
- Billing: new line item "Supplemental Pool (6 months)" billed monthly in arrears.
- SLA: default to existing committed SLA; if Helix elects lower-tier SLA, we apply a further 15% discount (note in redline).

Attachments included: redline-sow-helix-2027-08-02.docx (tracked changes) and a 1-page summary for procurement.

Next actions: 
1) Mina: confirm commercial approach with Helix (is monthly billing acceptable vs PO amortization).
2) Karthik/Marissa: quick legal check on the isolation language and any data-commingling clause tweaks (SOC2 reference + audit rights should remain). Target: legal thumbs-up by Tues 8/3 EOD.
3) If legal OK, I’ll convert to a concise DocuSign envelope and route to Sarah for signature.

Jordan Blake
Senior Sales Ops Manager, Redwood Inference

Attachment: redline-sow-helix-2027-08-02.docx

Date: Tue, 3 Aug 2027 15:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Draft redlines and execution plan (Helix supplemental)

Thanks, Jordan and Mina — this looks good at a glance. A few notes from procurement: 
- Monthly billing is preferred (Helix finance wants a predictable monthly line on the card).
- Isolation language is essential; we will not accept shared pools for the pilot.
- We have one minor privacy ask: include an explicit sentence referencing our Data Processing Annex (DPA) and that the supplement inherits those terms.

If legal can add a one-line DPA carve-in and confirm the isolation wording, we can sign the DocuSign envelope Thursday morning (8/05). Can you confirm the DocuSign routing (who signs at Helix)? I will be primary signatory; procurement will countersign.

Regards,
Sarah Lin
Head of Cloud Ops, Helix AI
